t: Avatrade
s: Virtually all the major trading pairs have the USD as a component, and these include the EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD, USDCAD, AUDUSD and the NZDUSD. Determining the direction of the USD is essential in determining the direction of the entire market. For instance, a EURUSD trader will buy the pair if the USDX is falling (implying decreasing dollar value) and sell it when the index is rising.

t: U.S. Dollar Index - Wikipedia
s: December 6, 2025 - The U.S. Dollar Index (USDX, DXY, DX, or, informally, the "Dixie") is an index (or measure) of the value of the United States dollar relative to a basket of foreign currencies, often referred to as a basket of U.S. trade partners' currencies. The Index goes up when the U.S. dollar gains "strength" ...
